name: 11 Domestic hot water and solar
description: The hot water of a dwelling in Sevilla: a solar tank that preheats the water and a condensing combi boiler in series

components.name: sevilla
components.description: Hourly weather of Sevilla (Spain), MET format: the irradiance on the collectors and the outdoor temperature

components.name: dhw_profile_day
components.description: Share of the daily DHW volume used in each hour (DB-HE, Anejo D table c), fraction per hour

components.name: dhw_profile
components.description: The profile all year: its variable 'values' times the daily volume is the hot water used (l/h)

components.name: collector
components.description: 2 m² of flat plate collectors facing south, 45° (EN ISO 9806 data)

components.name: solar_pump
components.description: Pump of the solar loop, 30 W, running while the collectors give heat

components.name: solar_generator
components.description: The collectors with their pump: the plant always takes their heat

components.name: solar_tank
components.description: 150 l solar tank in a room at 20 °C, standing loss 54 W (UA = 54 / 45 = 1.2 W/K)

components.name: solar_plant
components.description: Solar plant: the collectors heat the tank, which preheats the hot water (no other generator)

components.name: boiler
components.description: Condensing gas combi boiler, 24 kW: 0.98 with the water entering at 30 °C, 0.25 % less per K above

components.name: boiler_generator
components.description: The boiler, without pump: the mains pressure moves the water

components.name: boiler_plant
components.description: Instantaneous backup: 5 l of water at 60 °C, variable flow (only the water drawn goes through the boiler)

components.name: dhw
components.description: Dwelling of 3 bedrooms: 112 l/day at 60 °C (DB-HE Anejo F), preheated in the solar tank and finished by the boiler; mains water of Sevilla (Anejo G)

components.name: energy
components.description: Final energy by carrier: gas of the boiler, electricity of the solar pump and the solar thermal energy (renewable)
